subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should a configured cron delivery destination be copied into new jobs or dynamically inherited by existing jobs whose delivery fields are omitted?
rationale: The choice determines whether later configuration changes may silently redirect already-created unattended jobs, which is a recipient-security and product contract decision rather than a mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Copy On Creation
options.body: Persist the configured destination into each new job so later config changes cannot silently retarget existing jobs.

options.title: Inherit At Runtime
options.body: Resolve omitted job delivery from current config on every run, enabling centralized changes but allowing existing jobs to be retargeted.

options.title: Keep Explicit Only
options.body: Retain job-level recipient configuration and improve CLI/UI templates, previews, and warnings instead of adding inheritance.

recommendation.title: Copy On Creation
recommendation.body: Persist the configured destination into each new job so later config changes cannot silently retarget existing jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial-delivery centralization commit and prior focused triage make this the strongest available owner for the destination-stability decision.
